youtube.script:
Is your AI workflow actually saving time?
OpenAI’s new scorecard says AI should be judged by useful work completed, cost per successful task, dependability, and whether value improves at scale. That matters because a tool can look fast and still create hidden work if it needs retries, edits, or careful human cleanup before it’s usable. My simple test this week is to compare one real workflow against your normal process and count every retry and edit. If the cleanup is bigger than the time saved, the workflow is not ready to expand. Which would you measure first: retries or human edits? Drop one in the comments. Read the full breakdown through the link in our bio, or search Clearforge AI Briefing in your podcast app to listen on the go.
